statements.quote: Advanced Computing net sales increased by $93.9 million, or 16.9%, compared to the same period in the prior year, primarily due to higher hardware sales driven by increased demand for AI solutions and HPC.
statements.notes: The $93.9 million is the year-over-year increase in Advanced Computing segment sales, not an AI revenue figure. AI is named alongside HPC as a driver of the increase, so it is recorded as qualitative with total scope. fiscal_year comes from the preceding sentence's 'in 2025'; this sentence says 'compared to the same period in the prior year'.
